services.desc: Overview This comprehensive tour captures the essence of Niagara Falls, USA. Begin with a breathtaking journey to the Cave of the Winds, where you’ll feel the powerful rush of the Bridal Veil Falls up close. Next, embark on the iconic Maid of the Mist boat ride, getting a thrilling, panoramic view of the American and Horseshoe Falls from the water. Explore Niagara Falls State Park, the oldest state park in the U.S., and enjoy its scenic trails and historic landmarks. The tour also includes insightful commentary from expert guides, ensuring you get the most out of your visit. No passports required!
